[[File:Solar_power_generators.jpg|thumb|right|280px|Solar power generators on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]]]
A '''solar power generator''' was an electronic device that provided electrical power through the use of [[Solar collector/Legends|solar panels]] collecting [[Star/Legends|sun's]] energy. [[Ambient Solar Energy Surveying Tool]]s were used to locate areas where the generators could be placed for maximum power.
